t: Milwaukee M18 18V cordless angle grinder with Powerstate brushless motor delivers powerful performance, ensuring maximum power and extended durability for various cutting and grinding applications. Provides efficient material removal and precise cuts, ideal for demanding trade tasks such as metal fabrication or on-site cutting of steel. The 4 1/2" grinder features RapidStop technology, which halts the disc in under 2 seconds for enhanced safety, and a 115mm keyless guard to allow quick, tool-free guard adjustments. The 5.0Ah RedLithium battery provides ample run time, and the all-metal gearbox and dust-sealed bearings contribute to the grinder's robust construction and reliability. Supplied with battery, charger and Dynacase.
